description: Git sees `tests/test_a.py` renamed to `tests/checks_a.py`, a name pytest does not collect, with its test functions renamed to `check_*`: the file is kept in head's tree under another name and declares no test. TG001 says so (`Removes all 2 test declarations from tests/test_a.py (file kept, renamed to tests/checks_a.py)`), a WARN, not `Deletes the test file`. The real runner no longer runs either test.
